recommendation.summary: Plant soybean between Oct 10 and Nov 5.
recommendation.explanation: Soybean planted in this window flowers in December, before the cool and humid nights of January that favour white mold.

windows.explanation: Flowering ends before mid-January in most past years, when humid nights are most common.
Flowering moves into January. Cool, humid nights at flowering happened in 4 of the last 10 years.
Flowering would fall in the period with the most humid nights. White mold is likely, and the harvest gets close to the second-crop window.

events.label: White mold conditions
events.threshold: 3+ days in a row with mean temperature 15–22 °C and relative humidity ≥ 85 %
events.explanation: Cool, humid spells that favour white mold (Sclerotinia) at flowering happened in 4 of the last 10 years.

source.note: Past records, not a forecast. Risk = how often it happened in past years.
